summary: Contributors are refining definitions, expression support, portability across engines, determinism, and backward compatibility while the proposal remains in discussion. V4 manifests are now required to be written in Parquet A pull request adds per-task scanDuration metrics to the Spark‑Iceberg reader, enabling measurement of scan time per task. Participants consider reusing existing cluster spec and group stats, and debate compatibility and expression specification. Participants discussed upcoming roadmap items, integration with other data lake tools, and shared community feedback on feature requests.
